label: The probability of moving from state i to state j in one cycle equals the entry in row i and column j of the transition matrix, and each row of the transition matrix sums to one
tex: P = (p_{ij}), \qquad p_{ij} = \mathrm{P}(X_{t+1} = j \mid X_t = i), \qquad \sum_j p_{ij} = 1

label: The state distribution at the next cycle equals the state distribution at the current cycle multiplied by the transition matrix
Total discounted cost over a horizon equals the sum over each cycle of the discount factor to the power of the cycle, times the expected per-cycle cost under the state distribution at that cycle

Total discounted quality-adjusted life years over a horizon equals the sum over each cycle of the discount factor to the power of the cycle, times the expected per-cycle utility under the state distribution at that cycle

The Viterbi recurrence defines the best score of any path ending in state i at time t as the maximum over all previous states j of the previous best score for j plus the log transition probability from j to i, plus the log emission probability of the observation at t under state i
